selection.description: Marci's loyalty helps ensure survival, imbuing a chosen allied hero and herself with lifesteal and attack damage.
selection.gabenUpgrade: Gaben: Buffed heroes also heal from their partner's Sidekick lifesteal.
selection.name: Sidekick
selection.superUpgrade: Super: +25% lifesteal. Buffed heroes also gain Spell Immunity for 1.5 seconds.

selection.description: Links caster and their summons, sharing a percentage of their armor with each other, increasing the attack speed of both and causing damage dealt by the summons to heal the caster.
selection.differences: Works with all summons on the caster with reduced attack speed and shared lifesteal.
selection.name: Spirit Link

selection.description: The caster rips health away from all nearby units and uses it to heal an ally, or damage an enemy. Soul Rip can also be used to heal Tombstone.
selection.gabenUpgrade: Gaben: Becomes a 500 AOE spell (can work on allies & enemies at the same time). Gain Crimson Guard.
selection.name: Soul Rip

selection.description: Sends out a bolt of power that arcs between allies, healing them while damaging any enemy units standing nearby. Dazzle is always healed by Shadow Wave.
selection.name: Shadow Wave
selection.superUpgrade: Super: Shadow Wave hexes affected enemies for 2 seconds.

selection.description: Creates a spirit link between Death Prophet and an enemy unit, draining health from the enemy.
selection.gabenUpgrade: Gaben: +1 charges. Causes enemies continuously siphoned for 3 seconds to gain fear for 1.5 seconds.
selection.name: Spirit Siphon
selection.superUpgrade: Super: Now also siphons 3.5% of the target's max health per second. -20s charge replenish time, applies a 20% movement slow.
